visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark curly hair and a black t-shirt sits at a round wooden table, drinking from a white cup. He sits in a modern gym-like interior with warm, dim lighting and a prominent 'STEPX' sign on the wall behind him. (2) A larger, muscular man wearing a black and white sports jersey with 'TEAMJOINED' text and beige pants approaches the seated man from behind. The seated man notices him, looks startled, and quickly hides a small bottle under the table while maintaining a nervous expression. (3) The standing man places a hand on the seated man's shoulder. The seated man immediately contorts his face into an expression of extreme distress, covering his mouth and pretending to sob. He points toward the bottle while continuing the exaggerated crying performance. (4) The muscular man appears to comfort him by patting his shoulder and looking concerned. The seated man looks up with a fake, wide-mouthed crying face and then resumes his head-down position. (5) As the muscular man walks away toward the background, the seated man instantly stops crying, looks at the camera with a sly smile, and continues drinking from his cup with a satisfied expression.

This is immediately met by the main character emitting high-pitched, exaggerated crying sounds and sobbing, which creates a comical contrast with the aggressive music.
